title.zh: Low-k 材料：给金属线减负

subtitle.zh: 降低线间寄生电容、RC 延迟与串扰
subtitle.en: Reduce line-to-line capacitance, RC delay and crosstalk

body.zh: 核心结论：Low-k 的价值，是让相邻互连更难形成寄生电容
body.en: Key point: Low-k reduces parasitic capacitance between neighboring interconnects

body.zh: 却通常削弱机械强度并增加工艺损伤风险
body.en: but usually weakens mechanical strength and raises process-damage risk

body.zh: 碳损失/ 亲水化 / 吸湿/
量测反馈：FTIR / XPS / Capacitance / XSEM / Line-to-Line TDDB
body.en: Metrology feedback: FTIR / XPS / capacitance / XSEM / line-to-line TDDB

body.zh: Air Gap 是结构方案，不是普通 Low-k 薄膜
body.en: An air gap is a structural approach, not an ordinary Low-k film
